scenes.text: Have you ever wondered if there is a secret, lawless place on Earth where you could commit a major crime and completely get away with it?

Tucked deep inside the famous Yellowstone National Park lies a bizarre fifty-mile strip of land known as the Zone of Death, where a strange constitutional loophole makes prosecution legally impossible.

The United States Constitution strictly requires a criminal trial by a jury from the exact state and district where the crime occurred, but this completely uninhabited land sits in Idaho while the federal court district only controls Wyoming.
Since absolutely nobody lives in this dense forest to actually form a legal jury, a constitutional trial can never happen, so would you ever dare to camp here? Follow for more bizarre mysteries!
